run_hartree_fock_calculation: run a Hartree-Fock self-consistent field calculation on a molecule using the Scf class with pyscf
evaluate_molecular_orbitals: evaluate Hartree-Fock molecular orbitals at given electron positions using Scf.eval_mos
evaluate_slater_determinant: evaluate the Slater determinant sign and log absolute value for electron positions using Scf.eval_slater
compute_ordered_excitations: compute the lowest energy single and double excitations from a Hartree-Fock result using get_ordered_excitations
register_scf_pytree_node: register the Scf class as a JAX pytree node for flattening and unflattening with jax.tree_util
